source: X API public reads (get_users_posts) on 14 Nov 2026. Official accounts: original posts since 1 Oct 2026. @elonmusk and @nextbigfuture: company-relevant posts only (SpaceX, Starlink, Starship, SPCX, Starmind, Grok/SI). Short off-topic replies were omitted. created_at is the original X timestamp (UTC).
missing: No public official X account found for CFO Bret W. Johnsen (checked 11 Nov 2026).
@xai now redirects in bio to @SpaceXSI; @SpaceXAI was not a live handle.
@grok is a very high-volume product account and is linked from the page rather than fully ingested.

posts.name: SpaceX
posts.text: Starship and its heatshield are healthy as the vehicle continues to orbit Earth after a spectacular start to its mission nearly 7 hours ago. posts.text: Boca Chica Beach is not for sale, and SpaceX isn’t attempting to buy it. The beach is an important part of the Rio Grande Valley community, and SpaceX is investing substantial resources to preserve and improve it → https://t.co/bvKDh6ytRN https://t.co/Gv11dYWEQk
posts.summary: SpaceX says Boca Chica Beach is not for sale and that the company is not attempting to buy it, adding that the beach is an important part of the Rio Grande Valley community and that SpaceX is investing substantial resources to preserve and improve it. A 13 November Updates post linked from the tweet, titled “Restoring Boca Chica Beach,” says SpaceX has discussed buying about 1,200 acres of Texas Parks and Wildlife land surrounding the launch facility — with about 600 acres to be permanently conserved — and stresses that the beach is not part of that proposal and will remain public.

posts.name: Brian Wang
posts.text: @Investanswers It is not just the communication satellite to phone. It is mini data centers at or near every cell tower  and with the mesh of picocells with Tesla cars with starlink and starlink on homes and businesses and at superchargers.  AI5 chip in various boxes or form factors acting as first layer triage for ai inference network.
posts.summary: In a follow-up to his InvestAnswers livestream post, Brian Wang says the SpaceX idea is not just satellite-to-phone communications, but mini data centers at or near every cell tower plus a mesh of picocells on Tesla cars with Starlink, on homes and businesses, and at Superchargers. He adds that AI5 chips in various boxes or form factors would act as a first-layer triage for an AI inference network.

posts.name: Brian Wang
posts.text:

SpaceX is making moves to become the first AI carrier. My points which had some confirmation when Elon Musk reposted my earlier video on it are that today's cell towers are still mostly dumb radios, the Qualcomm deal is about making them AI-native, edge inference at the tower is like an updated Akamai for AI, and Starlink Direct-to-Cell and V3 sit alongside the terrestrial build.

posts.summary: Brian Wang says he will livestream with James of InvestAnswers at noon PST, under the title “How to Play the AI Spectrum,” and argues SpaceX is moving to become the first AI carrier. He repeats points he says Musk earlier reposted: that today’s cell towers are still mostly dumb radios, the Qualcomm deal is about making them AI-native, edge inference at the tower is like an updated Akamai for AI, and Starlink Direct-to-Cell and V3 sit alongside the terrestrial build.

posts.text:
Development of the Starbase supercompute site is creating an opportunity to address decades of environmental neglect. 

Portions of the property were used for unauthorized dumping dating back to the 1960s. We're undertaking cleanup efforts to remove decades of accumulated debris, https://t.co/XNNkiJqp0I
posts.summary: SpaceX says development of the Starbase supercompute site is creating an opportunity to address decades of environmental neglect, including unauthorized dumping on portions of the property dating back to the 1960s. It says it is cleaning up accumulated debris such as scrap metal, discarded appliances, old tanks, fiberglass insulation, construction materials and thousands of illegally dumped tires.

posts.name: Brian Wang
posts.text:
Grok Bot 1.0  is a massive upgrade as they all work together and take initiative automatically $SPCX 

Grok Bot team automatically collaborate with each other, take initiative, and continuously improve  

Here's what's NEW:  

1. MULTIPLAYER TEAMMATES  
• Share Grok Bots with https://t.co/jOl1ZtEXgU
posts.summary: Brian Wang calls Grok Bot 1.0 a massive upgrade for $SPCX, saying the bots now work together, take initiative automatically and continuously improve, quoting an XFreeze post on SpaceXSI’s official 1.0 launch. He lists new multiplayer teammate features (sharing bots, Slack and Microsoft Teams, and video meetings), proactive monitoring and follow-up, team-wide learning, and stronger browser, document and integration tools, arguing the biggest shift is that bots no longer need every task assigned.

posts.name: Brian Wang
posts.text:
SpaceX Colossus 2 AI data center campus has bought new property in the southwest. It is known as Project Mitchell. SpaceX also is getting approval for more power.

This is likely a new AI data center beyond the 5 already being built or near completion.

SpaceX has started buying https://t.co/bhflZtevA7
posts.summary: Brian Wang says SpaceX’s Colossus 2 AI data-center campus has bought new southwest property known as Project Mitchell and is getting approval for more power, which he sees as likely a new AI data center beyond the five already being built or near completion. An accompanying map labels Project Mitchell on the southwest side of a Colossus 2 campus that includes Macrohard buildings, and he adds that SpaceX has started buying nearby southeast homes, which he says would likely reduce power-plant noise issues, after SpaceXSI’s 1.2 GW Mississippi permit win.

posts.name: Brian Wang
posts.text: $SPCX gets  Mississippi 1.2 Gigawatt air permit https://t.co/Qw2LvkAduV
posts.summary: Brian Wang notes that SPCX has received a 1.2 gigawatt air permit in Mississippi, quoting an XFreeze post about the same decision. That post says Mississippi’s Environmental Quality Permit Board voted on 10 November to uphold the air permit for SpaceXSI’s permanent Southaven power plant after two days of testimony.

posts.name: Brian Wang
posts.text: $TSLA and maybe $SPCX might move HQ to Florida. https://t.co/KWzqvQIHe4
posts.summary: Brian Wang writes that Tesla, and maybe SpaceX, might move their headquarters to Florida, quoting a post that says Governor Ron DeSantis has invited Musk to relocate Tesla’s HQ from Texas. The quoted post is commentary about a political invitation after Democrats won in Texas, not a SpaceX or Tesla announcement that a move is happening.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.summary: Musk replies that 100 GW in space is roughly equal to 800 GW on Earth, arguing the two are not the same at all. He adds that terrestrial solar must be paired with massive batteries to keep compute running at night and supplemented with combustion or nuclear power in winter.

posts.name: Starlink
posts.text:
Home in rural Oklahoma is where this veteran and his wife enjoy the things that matter most.

With Starlink, they can stream, study, and stay connected with family and friends, reliably and seamlessly.

Discover their story this Veterans Day. https://t.co/dJDhgku0iK
posts.summary: Starlink posted a Veterans Day customer video featuring Marine veteran John Hassell and nursing student Ashley Hassell, who live on five acres about an hour southwest of Oklahoma City. They say they use the service for VA telehealth, Ashley’s online nursing degree, streaming, gaming and family video calls, and that coverage held up during recent tornado warnings; it is a marketing testimonial, not a new product or plan announcement.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text:
@IterIntellectus Actually, we’re aiming for 1TW/year from Earth, rising to over 1PW/year from the Moon. 

That’s why I say that if we achieve this outcome, SpaceX will obviously be worth more than Earth, because space is so staggeringly enormous!
posts.summary: Musk replies that SpaceX is aiming for 1 TW of capacity a year from Earth, rising to over 1 PW a year from the Moon, in response to a post about the company’s 100 GW-per-year solar equipment order. He adds that if that outcome is achieved, SpaceX will “obviously be worth more than Earth, because space is so staggeringly enormous.”

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text:
@zerohedge SpaceX has a chance of going about half the GW next year of actually usable compute. 

“Actually usable” is an important metric. It takes us ~2 months working 24/7 to get a large compute cluster working reliably. I’d guess closer to 6 months for others.
posts.summary: Replying to a ZeroHedge post on how much of developers’ data-center pipelines actually gets built, Musk says SpaceX has a chance next year of delivering about half the gigawatts as “actually usable” compute. He stresses that “actually usable” matters, saying it takes SpaceX about two months of 24/7 work to get a large cluster running reliably, and he guesses closer to six months for others.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text: Person for scale https://t.co/6XGX98l38L
posts.summary: Musk posts two photos captioned “Person for scale,” showing a person in a boom-lift basket beside a towering stainless-steel Starship or Super Heavy cylinder at a high-bay building. The images are a scale check on the vehicle hardware, posted minutes after he highlighted Super Heavy moving to the launch pad.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text: Starship Super Heavy rocket booster moved to launch pad https://t.co/Sn5VN93bww
posts.summary: Musk quotes SpaceX’s 10 Nov post that Super Heavy has been moved to the Starbase launch pad, writing “Starship Super Heavy rocket booster moved to launch pad.” The official SpaceX post identified Booster 22 as the first Super Heavy V3 planned to return for a catch and said it was used for a suspended squeeze test at catch height.

posts.name: SpaceX Super Intelligence
posts.text:
Introducing Grok Bot 1.0.

Bots can be shared and are more collaborative and capable than ever. https://t.co/gmxan7jupQ
posts.summary: SpaceX Super Intelligence introduces Grok Bot 1.0, saying bots can be shared and are more collaborative and capable than ever, with a promotional video. The post is the official SI-account launch note for the new teammate product.

posts.name: SpaceX
posts.text: Thank you to all those who have served, including the veterans we're proud to call members of the SpaceX family. Happy Veterans Day! https://t.co/SGpSvt1dby
posts.summary: SpaceX thanks those who have served, including veterans in the SpaceX family, and wishes a happy Veterans Day, with an accompanying image. It is a commemorative company post, not an operational or financial update.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text: Hire Grok @Bot as a colleague and give it your hardest tasks! https://t.co/yYTjZPGTiC
posts.summary: Musk urges people to “Hire Grok @Bot as a colleague and give it your hardest tasks,” quoting the official Grok Bot account’s 1.0 launch post. That announcement describes Grok Bots as AI teammates that can be shared, used in Slack and Teams, invited to meetings, and trained to become more helpful.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text:
@aaronburnett We would be happy to take the compute back. No problem.

But I think the opposite is going to happen.
posts.summary: Musk replies that SpaceX would be “happy to take the compute back. No problem,” but that he thinks “the opposite is going to happen,” in a thread about reports that Anthropic told sell-side analysts it may not extend a SpaceX compute contract beyond mid-next year. Those claims about contract size and revenue impact come from other posters in the thread, not from Musk or an official company statement.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text: @XFreeze Much appreciated, Mississippi ❤️
posts.summary: Musk replies “Much appreciated, Mississippi” to a post reporting that on 10 November Mississippi’s Environmental Quality Permit Board voted to uphold the air permit for SpaceXSI’s permanent Southaven power plant after two days of testimony. That project is described as about 1.2 GW from 41 permanent natural gas turbines to support Super Intelligence compute, including Colossus II.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text: Portable, lightning-fast Internet that works anywhere on Earth where Starlink is legal! https://t.co/dBf3iHkEGv
posts.summary: Elon Musk is amplifying Starlink’s Mini 2 launch, calling it portable, fast internet that works wherever Starlink is legal. The linked official Starlink post says Mini 2 adds a quick-swap battery (up to 4.5 hours), USB-C, and built-in Wi-Fi, with preorders open — a consumer-hardware push for the Connectivity business.

posts.name: Brian Wang
posts.text: $SPCX gets equipment to make 100 gigawatt of solar per year https://t.co/Ek90pSdLrg
posts.summary: Brian Wang notes that SPCX is getting equipment to make 100 gigawatts of solar per year, linking to related discussion of the SINGULUS order. That matches SpaceX’s and SINGULUS’s own announcements of a supply contract to scale HJT solar-cell lines for Starmind satellites in Bastrop, Texas.

posts.name: Brian Wang
posts.text: Elon musk reposted my video about SpaceX turning Dumb radio cell tower into a smart edge inference like Akamai for AI.  Elon had said 1000X more communication in the future will be AI to AI. Agents talking to Agents. This will require the network and starlink to be optimized for https://t.co/MR3LRbaaFt
posts.summary: Wang says Musk reposted his video arguing SpaceX is turning “dumb” cell towers into smart edge-inference nodes, in line with Musk’s comment that future traffic will be mostly AI-to-AI. The linked post is Wang’s longer $SPCX “AI carrier” thread; it is commentary, not a company filing.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text:
SpaceX has ordered 100 GW/year of HJT solar manufacturing equipment from Singulus in Germany. 

This is for Starmind to create a sentient sun. https://t.co/umtNyF9M7g
posts.summary: Musk says SpaceX has ordered 100 GW a year of HJT solar manufacturing equipment from SINGULUS in Germany “for Starmind to create a sentient sun.” SINGULUS’s own release confirms a supply contract for a turnkey HJT line, with the first line due in the first half of 2027 and a plan to support more than 100 GW of equipment as SpaceX scales satellite production in Bastrop.

posts.name: Brian Wang
posts.text:
SpaceX is making moves to become the first AI carrier $SPCX 

• Current cell towers are still mostly “dumb” radios. The Qualcomm deal is about making them AI-native.
• Edge inference at the tower, like an updated Akamai for AI
• Starlink Direct-to-Cell and V3 satellites https://t.co/BLMvRRKvFW
posts.summary: Wang argues SpaceX is moving to become the first “AI carrier,” pointing to the Qualcomm deal, edge inference at towers, and Starlink Direct-to-Cell and V3 satellites. It is investor commentary tying those already-announced pieces together, not a new official contract.

posts.name: SpaceX
posts.text: We have signed a major supply contract with SINGULUS to create a durable option for advanced solar cell manufacturing to support more than 100 GW of equipment as we accelerate the production of our Starmind satellites in Bastrop, Texas → https://t.co/a9bXuUK6Ti
posts.summary: SpaceX says it has signed a major supply contract with SINGULUS for advanced solar-cell manufacturing to support more than 100 GW of equipment as it speeds Starmind satellite production in Bastrop, Texas. That is official confirmation of a large solar-capex step for the satellite/AI-power roadmap.

posts.name: SpaceX
posts.text: Super Heavy moved to the launch pad at Starbase. Booster 22 is the first Super Heavy V3 booster planned to return to the launch site for catch and was used for final catch testing upon arrival, including a suspended squeeze test at catch height https://t.co/iYTX1e6DEH

posts.name: Starlink
posts.text:

posts.summary: Starlink introduces Mini 2, a next-generation portable kit with up to 4.5 hours on a quick-swap battery, USB-C charging, built-in Wi-Fi, and a claimed 60-second setup, and says preorders are open. For investors this is a new consumer hardware SKU meant to broaden portable Starlink use.

posts.summary: Wang reports that SpaceX has rewritten Grok 4.8 in C and C++, calling it a different improvement path from Grok 4.7. The post links to Musk’s own thread about dumping JAX and rewriting the training and inference stack; it is commentary on that engineering shift.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text: Turns out that the Starlink software, built for managing the movement of vast amounts of data through space and to the ground, is also very well suited to training super intelligence
posts.summary: Musk says Starlink’s software, built to move huge amounts of data through space and to the ground, is also well suited to training superintelligence. The comment ties the Connectivity stack to the Super Intelligence roadmap rather than announcing a new financial metric.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text:
@Dimdv99 @tetsuoai Not as good. Opus 5.5 is a masterpiece.

But Grok 5 should exceed Opus 5.5 and maybe that happens in 2 or 3 months, with continued acceleration thereafter.
posts.summary: Musk, asked about models, says Anthropic’s Opus 5.5 is “a masterpiece” but that Grok 5 “should exceed” it, perhaps in two or three months, with continued acceleration after that. That is a product-timeline comment from the CEO, not a dated backlog or revenue figure.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.summary: In a follow-up, Musk says the stack even includes some assembly, that superintelligence will one day write a better stack, and that the current code is “tight.” It continues the same thread about SpaceX rewriting its AI software in-house.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text:
@tetsuoai At SpaceX, we write our own headers and calculate our own time (includes leap seconds). Not many people will know what this means, but those that do will appreciate it.

The new Grok AI/SI training and inference stack is derived from incredible of work done by amazing engineers
posts.summary: Musk says SpaceX writes its own headers and calculates its own time (including leap seconds), and that the new Grok AI/SI training and inference stack comes from that engineering culture. For investors it underlines that Super Intelligence software is being built inside SpaceX, not only bought in.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text:
@cradrrat We have dumped JAX/SGLang and rewritten the entire RL and inference stack from scratch in C/C++, which took some extra time. 

Training (aka pre-training) is done. Lot of cleanup was needed on the SFT data to get that mostly right. Now, 4.8 is in RL and the evals are starting to
posts.summary: Musk says the team has dumped JAX/SGLang and rewritten the reinforcement-learning and inference stack from scratch in C/C++, that pre-training is done, and that Grok 4.8 is now in RL with evals starting. This is a concrete update on the model-training schedule after a time-consuming rewrite.

posts.text: Proud to be a part of this important initiative from NVIDIA https://t.co/1npeeNiG8O
posts.summary: SpaceX Super Intelligence says it is proud to be part of an important NVIDIA initiative, quoting an NVIDIA post. A partnership signal for the SI/compute stack, without new contract terms in the post itself.

posts.name: SpaceX
posts.text: Q3 2026 Financial and Operational Results https://t.co/Qrb0qeVG15
posts.summary: SpaceX posts a link and broadcast for “Q3 2026 Financial and Operational Results.” This is the official pointer to the earnings webcast and the same quarterly release in the press and filings feed.

posts.name: SpaceX
posts.text:
Q3 2026 highlights:
- Delivered revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161% year-over-year

- Successfully launched our first revenue-generating Starship mission, delivering 26 Starlink V3 satellites to our broadband constellation, representing approximately 10x the downlink capacity added https://t.co/Qr94io6PiW
posts.summary: SpaceX’s Q3 highlights post states $14.6 billion of revenue, up 161% year over year, and the first revenue-generating Starship mission, which delivered 26 Starlink V3 satellites with about 10 times the downlink capacity of a Falcon 9 Starlink launch. Those figures match the official earnings release.

posts.name: SpaceX
posts.text:
Our Q3 2026 earnings report is now public → https://t.co/IRQs4EDBsS

The live webcast with @ElonMusk, @Gwynne_Shotwell, and @BretWJ will begin in 30 minutes https://t.co/CGrKBe0lfo
posts.summary: SpaceX says the Q3 2026 earnings report is now public, linking the official PDF, and that a live webcast with Musk, Shotwell, and CFO Bret Johnsen would start in 30 minutes. This is the moment the quarterly results were posted for investors.

posts.name: Starlink
posts.text: In the last year, Starlink Mobile has connected more than 11 million people across @VEONGroup 3 key markets: Ukraine, Kazakhstan, and Bangladesh. For many, it provides a reliable way to send messages, voice notes, share location and more in places that cell towers cannot reach https://t.co/MlckaXDLWP
posts.summary: Starlink says Starlink Mobile has connected more than 11 million people in a year across VEON’s Ukraine, Kazakhstan, and Bangladesh markets, often for messaging and location when cell towers cannot reach. A scale update for the direct-to-cell product in those countries.

posts.name: Starlink
posts.text: We have worked closely with regulators, industry and operators in India for 5+ years, and built a network of dedicated systems, gateways, and other infrastructure all in-country to exclusively serve Indian traffic safely and securely - and all with the requisite government https://t.co/zG8nqXW8WM
posts.summary: Starlink says it has worked with Indian regulators, industry, and operators for more than five years and has built in-country systems, gateways, and infrastructure so Indian traffic stays in India, “with the requisite government” approvals implied in the truncated post. It is a regulatory-and-infrastructure update on the India market, not a statement that consumer service is already fully live nationwide.

posts.name: SpaceX Super Intelligence
posts.text:
Grok Voice 3.0 is available today in the API and Voice Agent Builder at $0.08/min. Read our blog to learn more:
https://t.co/LkxbuF7u65
posts.summary: SpaceXSI says Grok Voice 3.0 is in the API and Voice Agent Builder at $0.08 per minute and points to a blog with more detail. The official xAI/SpaceXSI post positions it as a priced enterprise voice product.

posts.name: SpaceX Super Intelligence
posts.text:
Introducing Grok Voice 3.0, the world’s most intelligent speech-to-speech model.

It excels at resolving customer calls, responds in under a second, and costs less than other frontier models. https://t.co/cfDRrkQPEc
posts.summary: SpaceXSI introduces Grok Voice 3.0 as a speech-to-speech model aimed at customer calls, with sub-second responses and a lower cost than other frontier models. The accompanying blog says it already handles millions of conversations a day at Tesla and SpaceX and is in the API at the prior price.

posts.name: SpaceX Super Intelligence
posts.text: Grok Voice 3.0 achieves frontier performance in voice agent tasks at 40% lower latency. At SpaceX, it resolves 70% of Starlink support calls on its own. https://t.co/94UCOQzqtG
posts.summary: A thread follow-up says Grok Voice 3.0 hits frontier voice-agent performance at 40% lower latency and already resolves 70% of Starlink support calls on its own at SpaceX. That is a concrete cost-and-automation claim for the Connectivity support organisation.

posts.name: Starlink
posts.text: Starlink's high-speed, low-latency internet is now available in Curaçao! 🛰️🇨🇼❤️ → https://t.co/dpthtwwVMl https://t.co/HXkwiFcJ4F
posts.summary: Starlink announces that service is now available in Curaçao and links the local order page. A small-market consumer launch that slightly widens the geographic footprint.

posts.name: SpaceX Super Intelligence
posts.text: Code with AI in @Cursor_ai, get work done with @Bot, chat and create with @Grok, and benefit from all @X Premium features. https://t.co/fItGfw4GRH
posts.summary: SpaceXSI says the unified X Subscription covers AI coding in Cursor, work with Grok Bot, Grok chat and creation, and X Premium features. It is the product-bundle follow-up to the plan unification announced in the previous post.

posts.name: SpaceX Super Intelligence
posts.text:
We've unified plans across Grok, Cursor, and X Premium.

Introducing The X Subscription. https://t.co/SvkrVvBa0p
posts.summary: SpaceXSI says it has unified plans across Grok, Cursor, and X Premium as “The X Subscription.” A packaging change that ties the consumer AI, coding, and X products together after the Cursor deal.

posts.name: Starlink
posts.text: For those impacted by the earthquake in Panama, Starlink is providing free service through November 10 to new and existing customers in the affected areas. We are coordinating with emergency response agencies to help restore connectivity in the hardest-hit communities   →
posts.summary: Starlink is giving free service through 10 Nov to new and existing customers in areas of Panama affected by an earthquake, and says it is coordinating with emergency agencies. A disaster-relief offer, not a pricing change in other markets.

posts.name: Starlink
posts.text: Starlink Mobile is providing nationwide emergency connectivity to @MasMovilPanama customers in Panama. Families, communities and businesses can stay in touch with loved ones via SMS. Coverage works best with a clear view of the sky 🛰️📱 https://t.co/czOh1xVCyi
posts.summary: Starlink Mobile is providing nationwide emergency connectivity to Más Móvil Panama customers so people can stay in touch by SMS, with coverage best under a clear sky. Another emergency direct-to-cell deployment, this time in Panama.

posts.name: Gwynne Shotwell
posts.text: Starlink Mobile is on a role!   Thank you ANATEL and @Baigorri1984 for approving Starlink Mobile’s priority spectrum rights to serve the  great people of Brazil. https://t.co/1HTFiwBhrj
posts.summary: Shotwell thanks Brazil’s ANATEL (and its then-head) for approving Starlink Mobile’s priority spectrum rights. It is official cheerleading for the same Brazilian spectrum decision described in the Starlink post.

posts.name: Starlink
posts.text:
ANATEL just scored a huge win for the people of Brazil by voting to approve Starlink Mobile's full 2 GHz access with our global S-band priority. 

Starlink will put this critical mid-band spectrum to work to make sure every Brazilian has access to high-speed mobile broadband on
posts.summary: Starlink says ANATEL voted to approve Starlink Mobile’s full 2 GHz access with global S-band priority, which the company says it will use for high-speed mobile broadband in Brazil. A key spectrum approval ahead of the later “now live with Vivo” announcement.

posts.name: Gwynne Shotwell
posts.text:
I have been a posting slug!

How about that launch triple header last week:  Starship, Crew 13, and Heavy!!!
Terrestrial low band spectrum acquisition and FCC approval for Starlink Mobile constellation!
And I am always relieved, grateful and proud when we complete a crew mission— https://t.co/YE3Ss1fdtD
posts.summary: Shotwell recaps a launch “triple header” — Starship, Crew-13, and Falcon Heavy — plus a terrestrial low-band spectrum acquisition and FCC approval for the Starlink Mobile constellation, and pride in completing a crew mission. A compact official summary of several operational and regulatory wins from that week.

posts.name: Starlink
posts.text: Starlink will deliver fast, reliable connectivity across @AmericanAir’s full mainline fleet so passengers can stream, game, work, and stay connected to family and friends throughout their travel 🛰️✈️ https://t.co/bhYVyZLUdE
posts.summary: Starlink will put its inflight service across American Airlines’ full mainline fleet so passengers can stream, game, work, and stay in touch. A large U.S. airline fleet win for the aviation vertical.

posts.name: SpaceX Super Intelligence
posts.text: Grok 4.7 is now live on Microsoft Foundry https://t.co/r450VLImFN
posts.summary: SpaceXSI says Grok 4.7 is live on Microsoft Foundry, with a video. A distribution update putting the model on Microsoft’s cloud marketplace.
